description: This file is a Perl module 'serverhelp.pm' that provides utility functions and constants for writing test servers in a Perl testing framework. It includes functions for logging, server naming, and filename generation for server-related files (PID, logs, commands, input/output). It also handles server characterization and naming conventions based on server type and IP version.

methods.name: logmsg
methods.description: Logs a message with a timestamp to the specified logfile.

methods.name: serverfactors
methods.description: Parses a server string to extract protocol, IP version, and ID number.

methods.name: servername_str
methods.description: Returns a formatted server name string suitable for presentation.

methods.name: servername_id
methods.description: Returns a server name string formatted for identification purposes.

methods.name: servername_canon
methods.description: Returns a canonical server name string suitable for filenames.

methods.name: server_pidfilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the server's PID file.

methods.name: server_portfilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the server's port file.

methods.name: server_logfilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the server's log file.

methods.name: server_cmdfilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the server's commands file.

methods.name: server_inputfilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the server's input file.

methods.name: server_outputfilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the server's output file.
